title: stachys recta var. sideritidoides
intro: Stachys recta var. sideritidoides, commonly known as Rock-hyssop, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its various health benefits, including its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Rock-hyssop include its ability to reduce inflammation, modulate the immune system, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenoid compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
